description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl if it isn't an Equipment already.
Barret's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Rebel, creating a Blood token which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl.
Repeat from step 2.
